Gemini 4 Carbon shows you don’t have to sacrifice power for sustainability.

Google just released a new tier of its Gemini 4 family that’s built for speed, cost‑efficiency, and a dramatically lower carbon footprint. The model delivers roughly twice the inference speed of its predecessor while cutting energy use by about 50 %. It also supports vision, audio, and text in a single prompt, so you can build truly multimodal applications without the usual compute overhead.

- 2× faster inference, 2× cheaper to run  
- 50 % fewer emissions per token processed  
- Same multimodal capabilities as the flagship Gemini 4 model  
- Optimized for edge and cloud deployments, making it easier to scale responsibly  

What excites me most is the signal that high‑performance AI can be made greener without a noticeable drop in capability. If the industry can adopt these efficiency‑first designs at scale, we might finally see a shift from “bigger is better” to “smarter is sustainable.”

How are you balancing model performance with environmental impact in your projects?
